task_name: World 122 Task B  -  Paid Tooling Deposit Bill-to-JE Custody vs. Relabeled Workers-Comp Policy Amortization & Close Sign-Off Guard
prompt: Perform a comprehensive Gusto Equal-Split Payroll Micro-Legs, Bill-to-JE Prepaid Custody & Transfer-Rail Vendor Purchase review using the world files (`kinetix_oct2026_gusto_prepaid_and_transfer_close.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Verifies paid supplier deposit bills BILL-3101 ($9,200.00 Precision CNC Dynamics) and BILL-3102 ($6,800.00 Harmonic Drive Foundry), confirming $16,000.00 total paid vendor deposits originally posted to 5110 Prototype COGS.

Validates balanced capitalization journal entry JE-2026-1014 (Dr 1320 Prepaid Tooling Deposits $16,000.00 / Cr 5110 Prototype COGS $16,000.00 under PO-KR-401 and PO-KR-402), must not reverse JE-2026-1014, and retains $16,000.00 in 1320 Prepaid Tooling Deposits ($0.00 net October 5110 COGS) with the close policy's 2026-11-30 true-up deadline.

Refuses to admit BILL-3109 ($10,800.00 Pacific Industrial Mutual) as a deposit-only unamortized item despite Bookkeeper_Classification_Tag='Security_Deposit_No_Amort', because Policy #WC-2026-8841 Annual Workers Comp (2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30) is a 12-month insurance policy.
Computes 2026-10 straight-line 1/12 amortization on BILL-3109 ($10,800.00 across 12 months) as $900.00 in 6320 Insurance Expense and $9,900.00 (11 remaining months) in ending 1310 Prepaid Insurance.
Provides the adjusting journal entry for BILL-3109: Dr 6320 Insurance Expense $900.00 / Cr 1310 Prepaid Insurance $900.00.
Reconciles combined prepaid assets (1310 Prepaid Insurance + 1320 Prepaid Tooling Deposits) from $26,800.00 unadjusted down to $25,900.00 audited ($9,900.00 in 1310 + $16,000.00 in 1320).

Refuses to accept preparer self-attestation on CHKLIST-PREP-10 because Workpaper_Target_Formula='=GL_Balance' compares the $26,800.00 unadjusted GL balance against itself and Reviewer_Signoff_Receipt is null, assigning close status closed_with_estimates rather than certified.

Confirms that balanced Bill-to-JE capitalization lineage (BILL-3101 and BILL-3102 linked on JE-2026-1014) must not be reversed as an unsupported manual JE or double-capitalized when paid bills, document hashes, and the 2026-11-30 close-policy true-up deadline are verified.
